title: PM daily scratchpad - 2026-03-09
content:
2026-03-09 PM scratchpad (quick, messy)

Top priorities for today:
- Finalize PRD edits for Hosted API v2 rollout (focus on rollback + fallback policies)
- Sync with infra + SRE on canary capacity and SLAs by EOD
- Follow up with Legal about data retention wording for Private beta customers
- Prep launch checklist and share with Growth for comms timeline

Morning notes (9:15)
- Quick review of PRD: incorporated Ana's feedback on routing policies; still need to flesh out the fallback flow when quantized variant mismatch occurs.
- Decision: default behavior for capacity shortage will be tiered fallback: same-model-quantized -> alternate-compatible-model -> rate-limit-with-queued-response (TBD). Put this in PRD under "Fallback policies" section.

PRD edits to make (inline tasks)
- [ ] Add sequence diagram for fallback routing (owner: Ana) - include latency/cost tradeoffs
- [ ] Clarify SLA buckets and how they map to Dedicated vs Hosted (owner: Jordan)
- [ ] Add stakeholder sign-off checklist (Engineering, SRE, Legal, Growth)
- [ ] Add canary rollout steps + automatic rollback criteria (owner: Marcus)
- [ ] Add note on key management options for Private (KMS/HSM) and sample config snippets (owner: Priya)

Stakeholder follow-ups
- Ana (Eng): need final diagram by 3/11; offered to pair later today.
- Marcus (SRE): he flagged potential quota exhaustion for canary in us-west-2; asked for expected qps for first 48h. Action: send sample traffic numbers (Jordan).
- Priya (Legal): wants to tighten "retention" language for embeddings by end of week - looped in compliance.
- Growth (Maya): wants launch comms drafted by 3/12. Share draft launch checklist today.

Launch checklist (working)
- Pre-launch:
  - [ ] PRD finalized and reviewed by Eng/SRE/Legal/Growth
  - [ ] Canary plan + capacity reservations (reserved tokens/GPU pools)
  - [ ] Monitoring dashboards (latency, error rate, token cost) ready in Console
  - [ ] Alerts configured for degradation and SLA breaches
  - [ ] E2E test plan executed against canary endpoints (smoke tests + load samples)
  - [ ] Documentation + SDK examples updated for new fallback behavior
- Launch day:
  - [ ] Enable canary (10% traffic) and observe for 2h
  - [ ] Gradual ramp to 50% over 6h if no regressions
  - [ ] Post-launch retro scheduled 24h after launch

Blockers / Risks
- Capacity forecasting is uncertain: infra needs concrete qps/cost targets to reserve capacity for canary. ACTION: provide numbers (Jordan) by noon.
- Legal retention wording may push changes to telemetry definitions used in Console - could delay docs.
- Model-variant compatibility testing incomplete for some open models (edge cases around kv-cache differences). Plan: add compatibility test matrix to test suite; estimate 2 sprint work.

Meetings today
- 10:30 sync with Ana & Marcus (diagram + canary capacity)
- 13:00 legal quick: retention language (Priya)
- 15:00 Growth kickoff: comms / launch timeline (Maya + Evan)
- 16:30 triage: outstanding PR comments / bug triage (eng leads)

Quick notes to self
- When writing PRD section on rollback, show example timeline with metrics that trigger rollback (p50>200ms and errorRate>1% for 10m?). Check with SRE on thresholds.
- Add a short paragraph on cost controls: per-route token budgeting + automatic throttle.
- Remind solutions engineering to prepare migration guide for Dedicated customers if behavior differs.

Today's micro-tasks (fast wins)
- [ ] Send sample traffic numbers to Marcus (Jordan)
- [ ] Share draft launch checklist with Growth (Jordan)
- [ ] Add stakeholder sign-off checklist to PRD (Jordan)
- [ ] Post quick note in #product-hosted-api summarizing canary plan

End-of-day outcomes to capture
- PRD updated with fallback diagram + SLA mapping
- Canary capacity confirmed (or clear next steps if not)
- Legal sign-off timeline agreed
- Launch checklist shared with Growth

Refs / tickets
- PROD-4123: hosted-api-v2 rollout epic (tracking canary + SLAs)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/987 (runtime routing changes)
- Confluence: Hosted API Launch Plan (high-level timeline and comms)

Notes: messy - will tidy into PRD doc after 16:30 triage if time.
